```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Fiber orientation of the old Keyence images (UMA outputs in data/uma_outputs_1), proCAF vs restCAF.
Writes the old_keyence_*.csv tables and fig01-fig11 pdfs to results/.

## set directory
```{r}
proCAF_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1/proCAF"
restCAF_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1/restCAF"
output_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1"
```

## packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(readxl)      # cell-tracking metadata (donor coverage section)
```

## output folder
All tables (.csv) and figures (.pdf) go to results/.
```{r}
RESULT_DIR <- "./results"
dir.create(RESULT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

## merge files
Merge each group's per-sample orientation csvs into one table.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# directories
proCAF_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1/proCAF"
restCAF_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1/restCAF"
output_dir <- "./data/uma_outputs_1"

# UMA files use either a -90..+89 or a -89..+90 grid of 1-degree bins. -90 and +90 are the
# same orientation (180 deg period), so fold -90 into +90 and join on angle, not row order.
merge_orientation_csvs <- function(dir_path) {
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "_orientation_distribution_processed\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  merged <- NULL
  
  for (f in files) {
    df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    
    # sample name = leading digits plus optional N/T
    sample_name <- basename(f) %>% 
      str_extract("^\\d+[NT]?")
    
    col_name <- paste0(sample_name, "_perc_occ")
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(corrected_angles = if_else(corrected_angles == -90, 90, corrected_angles)) %>%
      select(corrected_angles, !!col_name := perc_occvalue2sum_of_occvalue) %>%
      arrange(corrected_angles)
    
    merged <- if (is.null(merged)) df else full_join(merged, df, by = "corrected_angles")
    
    message("Added: ", sample_name)
  }
  
  merged <- merged %>% arrange(corrected_angles)
  
  # every file must land on the same -89..+90 grid
  stopifnot(nrow(merged) == 180,
            min(merged$corrected_angles) == -89,
            max(merged$corrected_angles) == 90,
            sum(is.na(merged)) == 0)
  
  return(merged)
}
```

Run it for both groups.

```{r}
message("Processing proCAF...")
proCAF_merged <- merge_orientation_csvs(proCAF_dir)
write_csv(proCAF_merged, file.path(output_dir, "proCAF_merged_orientation.csv"))

message("\nProcessing restCAF...")
restCAF_merged <- merge_orientation_csvs(restCAF_dir)
write_csv(restCAF_merged, file.path(output_dir, "restCAF_merged_orientation.csv"))

message("\nDone!")
```
Read the merged tables back and check them.
```{r}
proCAF_merged <- read_csv("./data/uma_outputs_1/proCAF_merged_orientation.csv")
restCAF_merged <- read_csv("./data/uma_outputs_1/restCAF_merged_orientation.csv")
head(proCAF_merged)
head(restCAF_merged)
```
## plots
Per-sample orientation distributions, one plot per group.

```{r}
# proCAF
proCAF_long <- proCAF_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -corrected_angles, 
               names_to = "sample", 
               values_to = "perc_occ") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "_perc_occ"))

n_pro <- length(unique(proCAF_long$sample))
pro_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFB6C1", "#FE46A5", "#C71585"))(n_pro)

p_pro <- ggplot(proCAF_long, aes(x = corrected_angles, y = perc_occ, color = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pro_colors) +
  labs(x = "Corrected Angle (°)", 
       y = "Percentage Occurrence", 
       title = "proCAF Orientation Distribution",
       color = "Sample") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

# restCAF
restCAF_long <- restCAF_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -corrected_angles, 
               names_to = "sample", 
               values_to = "perc_occ") %>%
  mutate(sample = str_remove(sample, "_perc_occ"))
n_rest <- length(unique(restCAF_long$sample))
rest_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#40E0D0", "#008080", "#004D4D"))(n_rest)

p_rest <- ggplot(restCAF_long, aes(x = corrected_angles, y = perc_occ, color = sample)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rest_colors) +
  labs(x = "Corrected Angle (°)", 
       y = "Percentage Occurrence", 
       title = "restCAF Orientation Distribution",
       color = "Sample") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

p_pro
p_rest

```

## statistical analysis

### alignment statistics per sample
w = perc_occvalue2sum_of_occvalue (% of fiber signal per 1-degree bin, sums to 100);
ang = corrected_angles (UMA puts each sample's dominant direction at 0; -89 to +90 deg).

| statistic | formula | units, range |
|---|---|---|
| mean_angle_deg | sum(w*ang)/sum(w) | deg, -90 to +90; near 0 |
| var_around_0_deg2 | sum(w*ang^2)/sum(w) | deg^2, 0 to 2700 |
| sd_around_0_deg | sqrt(var_around_0_deg2) | deg, 0 = parallel fibers, 51.96 = random |
| circular_variance | 1 - Mod(sum(w*exp(2i*ang))/sum(w)) | 0 = parallel, 1 = random |
| circular_sd_deg | rad2deg(sqrt(-2*log(r))/2) | deg, 0 to infinity (diverges as r -> 0) |
| perc_within_15deg | sum(w[abs(ang) <= 15]) | %, 0 to 100; UMA's own headline number |

The spread is taken around 0, not the sample's mean angle, since 0 is already the dominant
direction (908: 36.6 deg around 0 vs 32.2 deg centered). circular_variance saturates, so it is
reported next to sd_around_0_deg, not instead of it.

```{r}
# one long table with both groups
both_long <- bind_rows(
  proCAF_long  %>% mutate(group = "proCAF"),
  restCAF_long %>% mutate(group = "restCAF")
)

# per-sample alignment statistics (table above)
align_stats <- both_long %>%
  group_by(group, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    total_perc        = sum(perc_occ),                                    # sanity, must be 100
    mean_angle_deg    = sum(perc_occ * corrected_angles) / sum(perc_occ),
    var_around_0_deg2 = sum(perc_occ * corrected_angles^2) / sum(perc_occ),
    sd_around_0_deg   = sqrt(var_around_0_deg2),
    r_resultant       = Mod(sum(perc_occ * exp(2i * corrected_angles * pi / 180)) / sum(perc_occ)),
    circular_variance = 1 - r_resultant,
    circular_sd_deg   = (180 / pi) * sqrt(-2 * log(r_resultant)) / 2,
    perc_within_15deg = sum(perc_occ[abs(corrected_angles) <= 15]),
    perc_within_30deg = sum(perc_occ[abs(corrected_angles) <= 30]),
    peak_angle_deg    = corrected_angles[which.max(perc_occ)],
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(group, sd_around_0_deg)

# weights must sum to 100 per sample
stopifnot(all(abs(align_stats$total_perc - 100) < 1e-6))

# sd_around_0_deg of a uniform (random) matrix
uniform_sd <- sqrt(mean((-89:90)^2))
cat(sprintf("uniform (random) matrix reference: sd_around_0_deg = %.2f deg\n", uniform_sd))

align_stats %>% select(group, sample, sd_around_0_deg, circular_variance, perc_within_15deg)
```

### cross-check against UMA's own output

perc_within_15deg, recomputed from the merged distributions, must equal UMA's
Percentage_Fibers_Aligned_Within_15_Degree in Alignment_Summary.csv.

```{r}
uma_reported <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(file.path(proCAF_dir,  "Alignment_Summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(group = "proCAF"),
  read_csv(file.path(restCAF_dir, "Alignment_Summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(group = "restCAF")
) %>%
  transmute(group,
            sample = str_extract(File_Name, "^\\d+[NT]?"),
            uma_within15 = Percentage_Fibers_Aligned_Within_15_Degree,
            uma_call = Orientation_Mode)

align_stats <- align_stats %>% left_join(uma_reported, by = c("group", "sample"))

stopifnot(sum(is.na(align_stats$uma_within15)) == 0,
          max(abs(align_stats$perc_within_15deg - align_stats$uma_within15)) < 1e-6)
cat("cross-check passed: recomputed perc_within_15deg matches UMA's Alignment_Summary.csv exactly\n")
```

### which of these 15 matrices were also used in the cell-tracking experiment?

Old file names carry only MMDD plus N/T (804N#1, 1108_2_J); tracking_metadata.xlsx uses the
full cfECM donor (P220804N1). Each mapped donor must exist there with a matching cafType.

```{r}
TRACK_META <- "./data/data_tracking/analysis/tracking_metadata.xlsx"
track_meta <- read_excel(TRACK_META)

# old label -> cfECM donor; NA = not imaged in the tracking experiment
sample_to_donor <- tribble(
  ~sample,  ~donor,
  "015",    "P201015T1",
  "1207T",  "P231207T1",
  "229T",   "P240229T1",
  "804N",   "P220804N1",
  "804T",   "P220804T1",
  "815",    "P220815T1",
  "908",    "P220908N1",
  "0118N",  NA,
  "1108",   "P221108T1",
  "201N",   "P220201N1",
  "212",    "P220212T1",
  "509",    NA,
  "519",    "P220519T1",
  "711",    "P240711N1",
  "807",    "P140807T1"
)

align_stats <- align_stats %>% left_join(sample_to_donor, by = "sample")
stopifnot(nrow(align_stats) == 15, sum(is.na(align_stats$sample)) == 0)

donor_caf <- track_meta %>% distinct(cfECM, cafType)

# check 1: every mapped donor exists in the tracking metadata
mapped <- align_stats %>% filter(!is.na(donor))
stopifnot(all(mapped$donor %in% donor_caf$cfECM))

# check 2: the CAF call agrees between the two experiments
chk <- mapped %>% left_join(donor_caf, by = c("donor" = "cfECM"))
stopifnot(all(chk$group == chk$cafType))
cat(sprintf("mapping checked: %d of 15 old samples map to a tracking donor, all cafType calls agree\n",
            nrow(mapped)))

# coverage, seen from the tracking side
coverage <- donor_caf %>%
  rename(donor = cfECM) %>%
  left_join(align_stats %>% select(donor, sample, sd_around_0_deg, circular_variance, perc_within_15deg),
            by = "donor") %>%
  mutate(has_old_image = !is.na(sample)) %>%
  arrange(cafType, desc(has_old_image), donor)

coverage
cat(sprintf("\ntracking donors covered by an old Keyence image: %d of %d (%d proCAF of %d, %d restCAF of %d)\n",
            sum(coverage$has_old_image), nrow(coverage),
            sum(coverage$has_old_image & coverage$cafType == "proCAF"),  sum(coverage$cafType == "proCAF"),
            sum(coverage$has_old_image & coverage$cafType == "restCAF"), sum(coverage$cafType == "restCAF")))
cat("old samples with no tracking counterpart: ",
    paste(align_stats$sample[is.na(align_stats$donor)], collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("tracking donors with no old image: ",
    paste(coverage$donor[!coverage$has_old_image], collapse = ", "), "\n")

align_stats <- align_stats %>% arrange(group, sd_around_0_deg)
write_csv(align_stats, file.path(RESULT_DIR, "old_keyence_alignment_per_sample.csv"))
write_csv(coverage,    file.path(RESULT_DIR, "old_keyence_tracking_donor_coverage.csv"))
```

### is restCAF matrix more aligned than proCAF matrix?

Welch t-test and Wilcoxon rank-sum, on all 15 samples and on the 13 with tracking data.
One image per donor, so n counts donors (7 vs 8).

```{r}
group_tests <- bind_rows(
  lapply(c("sd_around_0_deg", "circular_variance", "perc_within_15deg"), function(m) {
    bind_rows(
      lapply(list(all15 = align_stats, tracked13 = filter(align_stats, !is.na(donor))), function(d) {
        a <- d[[m]][d$group == "proCAF"]
        b <- d[[m]][d$group == "restCAF"]
        tt <- t.test(a, b)
        wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(a, b))
        tibble(metric = m, n_pro = length(a), n_rest = length(b),
               mean_pro = mean(a), mean_rest = mean(b), diff_pro_minus_rest = mean(a) - mean(b),
               t = unname(tt$statistic), p_ttest = tt$p.value, p_wilcoxon = wt$p.value)
      }), .id = "subset")
  })
) %>% relocate(subset, .after = metric)

group_tests
write_csv(group_tests, file.path(RESULT_DIR, "old_keyence_group_tests.csv"))
```

### figures

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
var_comparison <- align_stats %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("proCAF", "restCAF")),
         grp   = factor(paste0(group, "\n(n = ", ifelse(group == "proCAF", 7, 8), ")"),
                        levels = c("proCAF\n(n = 7)", "restCAF\n(n = 8)")))

# Welch p per metric, taken from group_tests
p_all15 <- group_tests %>% filter(subset == "all15") %>% select(metric, p_ttest) %>% deframe()

p_sd <- ggplot(var_comparison, aes(grp, sd_around_0_deg, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = uniform_sd, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = uniform_sd - 2, size = 3, color = "grey40",
           label = sprintf("%.1f\u00b0 = random matrix", uniform_sd)) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = uniform_sd + 2.6, size = 3.1,
           label = sprintf("Welch's t-test, p = %.3f", p_all15[["sd_around_0_deg"]])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, uniform_sd + 4)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "SD around dominant direction (degrees)",
       title = "Fiber orientation spread, old Keyence images") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

p_cv <- ggplot(var_comparison, aes(grp, circular_variance, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 0.97, size = 3.1,
           label = sprintf("Welch's t-test, p = %.3f", p_all15[["circular_variance"]])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Circular variance (0 = parallel, 1 = random)",
       title = "Circular variance, old Keyence images") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

p_w15 <- ggplot(var_comparison, aes(grp, perc_within_15deg, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.4) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = group), width = 0.12, size = 2.5, alpha = 0.9) +
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 97, size = 3.1,
           label = sprintf("Welch's t-test, p = %.3f", p_all15[["perc_within_15deg"]])) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(proCAF = "#C4366E", restCAF = "#006666")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fibers within 15\u00b0 of dominant direction (%)",
       title = "Percent aligned within 15\u00b0, old Keyence images") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), legend.position = "none")

p_sd
p_cv
p_w15
```
